name: Camera Resolution
description: Different camera resolutions may affect the processing time of the onboard classifier or the human operator's analysis.

name: Image Size
description: Large images may take longer to process or transmit, leading to multimodal distribution.

name: Onboard Classifier Accuracy
description: Variations in the onboard classifier's accuracy may lead to different analysis times.

name: Human Operator Expertise
description: Differences in human operator expertise may lead to variations in analysis times.

name: Task Difficulty
description: Tasks requiring more complex analysis or decision-making may take longer, leading to multimodal distribution.

name: Network Bandwidth
description: Variations in network bandwidth may affect the transmission time of images and analysis results.

name: UAV Speed
description: Faster or slower UAV speeds may affect the time available for analysis at each waypoint.

name: Waypoint Distance
description: Longer or shorter distances between waypoints may affect the time available for analysis.

name: Environmental Conditions
description: Weather conditions, lighting, or other environmental factors may affect image quality and analysis time.

name: Time of Day
description: Variations in the time of day may affect human operator workload or UAV performance.

name: Battery Level
description: Lower or higher battery levels may affect UAV performance or analysis time.

name: Onboard System Load
description: High or low onboard system load may affect analysis time or UAV performance.

name: Image Compression
description: Different image compression settings may affect analysis time or image quality.

name: Human Operator Workload
description: High or low human operator workload may affect analysis time or accuracy.

name: UAV Type
description: Different UAV types may have varying performance characteristics affecting analysis time or accuracy.
